signals.title: Codex can stage host metadata before a reserved thread is materialized
signals.title_zh: Codex 可在线程实例化前为预留线程暂存宿主元数据
signals.summary: Codex adds reserved thread identities and lets the thread store stage host-owned metadata before Core starts the thread, merging that metadata on the first successful materialization and cleaning it up if the thread never materializes.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 增加预留线程身份，并允许线程存储在线程由 Core 启动前暂存宿主拥有的元数据；首次成功实例化时合并这些元数据，若线程未实例化则清理暂存状态。

signals.title: Codex keeps active-turn model and approval settings stable until the next turn
signals.title_zh: Codex 将活动轮次的模型与审批设置冻结到下一轮再更新
signals.summary: Codex snapshots model, reasoning, service-tier, approval and model-attributed telemetry settings into step context so a thread update cannot change execution semantics partway through an active turn; updates take effect on the next turn.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将模型、推理、服务层级、审批以及模型归属遥测设置快照到 Step Context，避免线程设置更新在活动轮次中途改变执行语义；新设置从下一轮开始生效。

signals.title: Codex separates executor policy audit telemetry from persistent state logs
signals.title_zh: Codex 将执行器策略审计遥测与持久状态日志分离
signals.summary: Forwarded network-policy decisions now use a log-only OpenTelemetry target, preserving exportable audit evidence while keeping those events out of the persistent runtime state log.
signals.summary_zh: 转发的网络策略决定现在进入仅日志的 OpenTelemetry 目标，在保留可导出的审计证据同时，不再把这类事件写入持久运行状态日志。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK isolates sandbox working directories per run
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 按运行隔离沙箱工作目录
signals.summary: The Agents SDK adds run-scoped sandbox working directories, tightening filesystem isolation between independent agent runs rather than relying on one shared sandbox working location.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 增加按运行范围划分的沙箱工作目录，加强不同 Agent 运行之间的文件系统隔离，而不是依赖同一个共享沙箱工作位置。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK preserves exact tool-call approval decisions
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 精确保留工具调用审批决定
signals.summary: The Agents SDK fixes approval handling so the exact decision attached to a tool call is honored, strengthening the link between human or policy authorization and the concrete action that is executed.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 修复审批处理，使绑定到具体工具调用的精确审批决定得到遵守，加强人工或策略授权与实际执行动作之间的对应关系。

signals.title: Google ADK bounds in-memory retrieval to the ten most relevant events
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将内存检索限制为相关性最高的十个事件
signals.summary: ADK now ranks in-memory search results by distinct query-word overlap and returns only the ten best events, preventing broad low-relevance retrieval from flooding each model call through preload_memory.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在按不同查询词的匹配数量排序内存检索结果，并只返回最佳十个事件，避免低相关的大量历史内容通过 preload_memory 灌入每次模型调用。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK closes all MultiProvider children after failures
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在失败后关闭全部 MultiProvider 子提供者
signals.summary: The Agents SDK changes MultiProvider failure cleanup so all child providers are closed after failures, reducing leaked lifecycle state and improving failure containment across provider fan-out.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 调整 MultiProvider 的失败清理逻辑，在失败后关闭全部子 Provider，减少生命周期状态泄漏，并改善 Provider 扇出场景的故障隔离。

signals.title: Codex TypeScript SDK adds ordered raw configuration overrides
signals.title_zh: Codex TypeScript SDK 增加有序原始配置覆盖
signals.summary: The TypeScript SDK can now pass ordered raw CLI configuration overrides for TOML structures such as permission maps with literal path keys, while retaining explicit precedence with SDK-managed and thread-specific settings.
signals.summary_zh: TypeScript SDK 现在可以为包含字面路径键的权限映射等 TOML 结构传递有序的原始 CLI 配置覆盖，同时保持与 SDK 管理设置和线程级设置之间的明确优先级。

signals.title: Codex adds a protocol-safe health endpoint to its code-mode gRPC listener
signals.title_zh: Codex 为 code-mode gRPC 监听器增加协议安全的健康检查端点
signals.summary: The code-mode listener now serves GET /healthz over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 while continuing to require HTTP/2 for all other requests, adding operational health probing without exposing gRPC methods through HTTP/1.1.
signals.summary_zh: code-mode 监听器现在可通过 HTTP/1.1 和 HTTP/2 提供 GET /healthz，同时其他请求仍强制使用 HTTP/2，从而增加运维健康探测但不把 gRPC 方法暴露给 HTTP/1.1。

signals.title: Codex doctor adds workspace storage and Windows Dev Drive diagnostics
signals.title_zh: Codex doctor 增加工作区存储与 Windows Dev Drive 诊断
signals.summary: codex doctor now checks free space for CODEX_HOME and the active worktree, applies warning/failure thresholds, and on Windows reports whether the active worktree is on a trusted Dev Drive with remediation guidance.
signals.summary_zh: codex doctor 现在检查 CODEX_HOME 与活动工作树的可用空间并应用警告/失败阈值；在 Windows 上还会报告工作树是否位于受信任的 Dev Drive，并给出修复提示。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK normalizes apply_patch paths to POSIX form
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 将 apply_patch 路径规范化为 POSIX 形式
signals.summary: The Agents SDK normalizes apply_patch paths to POSIX form inside the sandbox path model, reducing cross-platform path ambiguity in agent-generated patches.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 在沙箱路径模型中将 apply_patch 路径规范化为 POSIX 形式，降低 Agent 生成补丁时的跨平台路径歧义。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK improves reasoning replay for Chat Completions
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 改进 Chat Completions 的推理重放
signals.summary: The Agents SDK fixes reasoning replay behavior on the Chat Completions path, improving continuity when prior reasoning-associated state must be reconstructed across calls.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 修复 Chat Completions 路径上的推理重放行为，提高在跨调用重建先前推理相关状态时的连续性。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK includes compaction usage in run-level accounting
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 将压缩用量计入运行级统计
signals.summary: Session compaction usage is now included in run-level usage totals, making runtime cost and token accounting more complete for long-running agent sessions that compact context.
signals.summary_zh: 会话压缩产生的用量现在计入运行级用量总计，使需要压缩上下文的长时 Agent 会话在成本与 Token 统计上更加完整。
